title: Neuro drives national retail wins with ChatGPT Business
summary: Neuro uses ChatGPT Business to scale nationwide with fewer than 70 employees, saving time, reducing costs, and turning faster execution across sales and operations into growth.
body: Neuro uses ChatGPT Business to scale nationwide with fewer than 70 employees, saving time, reducing costs, and turning faster execution across sales and operations into growth.
summaryZh: Neuro公司利用ChatGPT Business优化销售与运营流程，在不到70名员工的情况下实现了全国范围的业务扩张。该案例体现了AI工具在降低运营成本与提升执行效率方面的实际价值。
